notes.title: New Massive Update for LitD
notes.content:
Get ready guys, this time we changed a lot, we've listen to the community, we've worked in the past months fixing problems, adding new things and adjusting the game like you guys asked...so HERE WE GO!

Change log:
- Account: Gamesparks has been entirely removed. This prevents save files from being shared across devices, but allows users to play entirely offline/without any third party account.
- Saves: users can now delete save slots. Mistakes were made.
- Balance: minimum life has been set to 20, and several items/abilities have been buffed.
- Fix: ice markers were not being transferred correctly to the next room.
- Fix: some achievements were not tracked correctly.

notes.title: Concerning the third party account
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32193980/2c98f5b437b8b0bab1424d8a8bc11b23e608b6ea.jpg[/img]

Dear community,

some users have been asking the reason for the account registration at the beginning of the game or have decided not to buy it because of the 3rd party account requirement. We'd like to spend a couple of words about this.

First of all you may or may not know that Lost in the Dungeon is available either on Steam, Android and iOS: our thought was that a player could start an adventure on a device and continue with it everywhere, in the bus, at the toilet, at friend's house and so on. So we thought that implementing a [b]shared saves system[/b] was a good idea.

What we're requiring when you register is a[b] mail address[/b]: the reason for it is solely the possibility of [b]recoverying your password[/b] if necessary. After the first login the device will automatically login without asking any further steps. After the registration, the game will work even without any connection, which means it [b]CAN[/b] be played offline, at your own risk: your save data are available only in that very device.

One of our highest priorities right now is revising the [b]privacy policies[/b]: they were written for the mobile version of the game so we need to update them for the Steam version.

Furthermore, we aren't asking you any mail validation, which means that if you are not willing to use your mail you can use a fake one and play with that. Of course, in this case if you forget your password we won't be able to help you in any way, so the choice is yours.

To us it is really important to clarify our good faith: we are a very small team, we've put a lot into this game, lots of passion and commitment and we're considering every single feedback to improve. We thank you very much for the point of view you're giving to us, this will surely be something we'll be thinking of for the future.

As always, if you have any questions, don't hesitate to contact us at support@lostinthedungeon.com

Cheers,
the Lost in the Dungeon team

notes.title: Patch 1.05
notes.content:
Here we are!

A new patch is available!
We worked on fixing [b]seventh room's bug[/b] of the first dungeon and we succeeded, we implemented the save of [b]last logged email[/b] (as some of you suggested), optimized assets in all platforms, polished some graphics and other minor fixes!


Have a nice weekend in the Dungeon!

notes.title: Patch 1.04 - Bug Fixing
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we're back!

Thanks for support, your feedbacks help us to improve the stability of lost in the dungeon.
We have worked on your reports and below you can read the summary of bugs that should be solved:

• Locked abilites bug
• Offline mode
• Synchronization with [b]mobile devices[/b]

I also report that for users with corrupt data, you will see blocked skills again, but I have provided you [b]all[/b] your skill points!

We look forward,
Luca.

notes.title: Patch 1.03 - Bug Fixing
notes.content:
Yesterday's fix of the [b]deck save[/b] temporarily solved the bug to some users, but the ones who had their data already corrupted still encounter the issue.
Now this should be fixed for everyone, please give us feedback about this if you are still having problems with this.

We're sorry for the inconvenience caused to some of you and hope we can promptly solve any issues you might have, thank you for your cooperation!

notes.title: Patch 1.01 - Bug Fixing and Optimization
notes.content:
Hello everyone and thank you all for your support! It means a lot to us!

In these past days we read all your feedbacks and we worked hard to provide a new build as soon as possible.

In this new release the changes made are as follows:
• Performance optimization
• Now it is possible to close game also on authentication scene
• Cap to 144 fps
• Time to enter the dungeon has been halved
• Bug fixing concerning the reports received

That's it for the moment, thank you again for your support.
